articles.title: One full bitcoin now buys a little more than 18 ounces of gold, the most since January
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is pulling ahead of gold even as both hard assets rally together, driven by fears that governments will inflate away their debt rather than by bond yields.

articles.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80K as DXY falls amid continuing suspected yen intervention
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rallied 5% to reclaim $80,000 as the US dollar weakened amid a suspected Bank of Japan currency intervention, though analysts remain split on the impact.

articles.title: BitMEX co-founder contributed 75% of Reform UK’s donations in Q2 2026
articles.snippet: The UK political party and its leader, Nigel Farage, have accepted contributions from figures tied to the crypto industry, raising questions about potential influence on policies.

articles.title: FBI Seizes $560K in Crypto Bound for Hamas, Takes Over Fundraising Sites
articles.snippet: Agents seized digital assets, domains, and servers allegedly used by Hamas’ military wing to collect donations and recruit supporters.

articles.title: OpenAI's Astra Becomes Its First AI Model With 'Critical' Hacking Abilities
articles.snippet: The unreleased model can find zero-day vulnerabilities and chain them into working exploits without a human walking it through each step, and access to that capability is starting with a small group of testers.
